mechanics.title: Cycle trades
mechanics.description: Works on villagers that have not been traded with; once you trade, the offers lock as in vanilla.

qol: Button position in the trading GUI is configurable.
getting_started: Open a villager's trade screen and press the cycle button or C.
editor_notes: Pack's villagertweaks config does not affect cycling.
name: Trade Cycling
summary: Adds a button and a key in the trading screen to re-roll the offers of a villager you have not traded with yet, instead of breaking and replacing its workstation.
